subject: Invoice headers for PO-less vendors & portal token strategy
messages:
From: Ellis Harper <ellis@lumenai.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on invoice headers for Redwood

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We're spinning up billing for Redwood and had a quick question about what minimum header fields you need when we send invoices via the portal vs email. A few specifics:

- For PO-less engagements (monthly SaaS fee) do you require a PO field at all, or is an "account reference" enough?
- If we upload via portal, is a portal token required per invoice or per account?
- For email fallback, what's the minimum set of fields so AP can auto-route to the right ledger (company name, Redwood account id, billing address, line items, tax)?

I've attached a draft invoice (PDF) and a screenshot of the portal screen we saw. If it's easier, we can hop on a 20-min call.

Thanks,
Ellis Harper
Head of Finance Operations
LumenAI
ellis@lumenai.co | +1 415-555-0142
Attachment: LumenAI_sample_invoice.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Harper <ellis@lumenai.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice headers for Redwood

Thanks Ellis — appreciate the packet and the clear questions. High-level answers below; Karthik (AP) and Vanessa (vendor ops) are cc'd to confirm.

1) PO-less vendors: We do not require a PO for recurring SaaS subscriptions. Instead, provide a Redwood Account ID (format RDW-xxxxx) in the invoice header. That field drives ledger routing.

2) Portal tokens: If you use the portal upload (preferred), we require a portal token at the account level (one-time link per vendor account). You do NOT need to generate a new token per invoice. The token ties the upload to the vendor record for automatic acknowledgement.

3) Email fallback minimum fields: if emailing invoices to ap@redwood.com, include at least these header fields in the body or the PDF meta: Redwood Account ID, Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Total Amount, Currency, Billing Address, and Line Items with tax breakdown. Vendor tax ID is helpful.

Vanessa / Karthik — can you confirm the auto-acknowledgement subject token we should provide back to LumenAI, and whether AP can auto-ingest invoices that include "Account Ref" instead of a formal PO?

—Jonas
From: Ellis Harper <ellis@lumenai.co>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice headers for Redwood

Thanks Jonas — that helps a lot. Two quick follow-ups after reviewing the sample:

- We currently put "Account Ref" in the PDF header (human-readable) but don't map a structured RDW- id into the filename or PDF metadata. Will that block auto-ingest?
- Portal flow: our onboarding team is asking whether the one-time portal token can be minted by vendor self-service or if your vendor ops team needs to create it.

Attached: annotated screenshot of the portal and our sample invoice with the Account Ref highlighted.

If you prefer, Karthik and I can take a short call tomorrow 9–9:30 PT to finish the mapping.

Best,
Ellis

Hi Ellis — sorry for the delay, wanted to confirm with vendor ops. Short answers and an action plan below.

- Account Ref vs RDW-id: Our auto-ingest prefers a structured RDW- account id. If you can't stamp RDW-xxxxx in the PDF metadata or filename, we can attempt a fuzzy match on "Account Ref" but that will be queued for manual review ~24–48 hours. For predictable automation, please include RDW-xxxxx in the PDF header or filename (e.g., RDW-12345_invoice_202610.pdf).

- Portal token minting: Vendor self-service is supported. Your onboarding user can request a token from the portal > Billing > Integrations. If you prefer we can generate the token and email it; if so, reply with your vendor tax id and the email for the onboarding admin and Vanessa will create it.

Action items: 
1) Can you send one invoice with the RDW-xxxxx in the filename so we can confirm auto-ingest mapping?
2) If you want vendor ops to mint the token, reply with: vendor legal name, tax id, and onboarding-admin email — Vanessa will create and send the token.

We will send a short acknowledgement back on successful auto-ingest containing the upload id and a merchant token you can store.

Thanks — Karthik
Accounts Payable Lead, Redwood Inference
